Isaac earned degrees in Computer Science and Business Administration from UC Berkeley.

founders.name: Brad Brenner

Brad kicked off his entrepreneurial journey at the age of 7 and has started 4 businesses prior to Joon. At Joon, he takes point on all things operational from product development, user research, growth & marketing to financial planning and forecasting. Originally from Romania, Brad graduated from UC Berkeley with a degree in Business Administration.

founders.name: Kevin Bunarjo

As a kid, Kevin spent countless hours playing video games (Minecraft, Runescape, Pokemon, Tetris being the top games) and hopes he can use Joon to leverage the fun of games to motivate kids to be productive in real life. Kevin graduated from UC Berkeley with degrees in Computer Science and Business Administration. Although he lives in the Bay Area now, he is originally from Jakarta, Indonesia.
